title: chore(deps): bump @objectstack/* from 9.11.0 to 10.0.0
body:
## Summary

Upgrade `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/formula` from `^9.11.0` to `^10.0.0` across all workspace packages and apps (12 `package.json` files + `pnpm-lock.yaml`). All four packages (incl. transitive `@objectstack/core`) resolve to `10.0.0`.

`@objectstack` 10.0.0 is the **ADR-0058 expression/predicate unification** — almost entirely server-side (CEL→FilterCondition pushdown, RLS enforcement, build-time predicate validation). Every symbol objectui consumes is unchanged, so no API migration was needed:

- `@objectstack/spec/ui` (all consumed types/schemas), `Expression`
- `@objectstack/client`: `ObjectStackClient`, `QueryOptions`
- `@objectstack/formula`: `ExpressionEngine`
- `ai` / `zod` peer/deps already matched (`^6.0.0` / `^4.4.3`) — no peer change.

## Incidental fix

`packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx` had a **pre-existing** latent type error (`handleTabChange(tab.id)` passing `string | undefined`) that turbo's cache was masking — confirmed failing identically on `9.11.0`. The package.json change busts that cache, so it's fixed here: tab identity now resolves `id ?? name` (the convention `normalizeTabPresets` already uses). No behavior change for tabs that have an `id`.

## Verification

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm type-check` | ✅ 60/60 tasks |
| `pnpm build` | ✅ 42/42, exit 0 |
| `pnpm test` | ✅ 4250 passed, 24 skipped |

The single test "failure" in the full run (`useResponsiveSidebar`) is a flaky timeout under machine load — zero objectstack references, passes in isolation.
